title: A galaxy of one hundred eighty services
description: 8 domains self-organize · node = call volume · drag anything, the galaxy fights back · click empty space to replay

props.name: data
props.description: Services with stable IDs, display names, nullable nonnegative daily calls in thousands, hub flag and nonnegative domainIndex for the preserved eight-tone cycle.

props.name: edges
props.description: Source/target IDs, nullable nonnegative encoded width, and spoke/shortcut/backbone/stray treatment. Width is caller data because the original specimen derived it from unrounded traffic. Unknown endpoints are omitted; duplicate directed links keep their first occurrence.

props.name: height
props.description: Optional total component height in pixels; otherwise retains the original plot proportions.

props.name: width
props.description: Optional fixed width in pixels; otherwise fills its containing element.

props.name: animate
props.description: Enable token-timed motion subject to the system reduced-motion preference.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional classes on the component container.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible description of what this instance measures.
